entries.title: Joshua 12:1
segments: ¶And these are the kings of the land, whom the children of Israel smote, and of whose land they took possession across the Jordan, toward the sun-rising, from the river Arnon to mount Hermon, and all the plain on the east:

entries.title: Joshua 12:2
segments: Sihon the king of the Amorites, who dwelt at Heshbon, [and] ruled from Aroer, which is upon the bank of the river Arnon, and from the middle of the ravine, and over half Gilead, as far as the river Jabbok, [which is] the border of the children of Ammon;

entries.title: Joshua 12:3
segments: and the plain as far as the sea of Chinneroth on the east, and as far as the sea of the plain, the salt sea, on the east, toward Beth-jeshimoth; and on the south, under the slopes of Pisgah;

entries.title: Joshua 12:4
segments: and the territory of Og the king of Bashan, of the residue of the giants, who dwelt at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,

entries.title: Joshua 12:5
segments: and ruled over mount Hermon, and over Salcah, and over all Bashan, as far as the border of the Geshurites and the Maachathites, and [over] half Gilead [as far as] the border of Sihon the king of Heshbon.

entries.title: Joshua 12:6
segments: Moses the servant of Jehovah and the children of Israel smote them, and Moses the servant of Jehovah gave it for a possession to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to half the tribe of Manasseh.

entries.title: Joshua 12:7
segments: ¶And these are the kings of the land whom Joshua and the children of Israel smote on this side the Jordan on the west, from Baal-Gad in the valley of Lebanon as far as the smooth mountain, which rises toward Seir. And Joshua gave it to the tribes of Israel for a possession according to their divisions,

entries.title: Joshua 12:8
segments: in the mountain, and in the lowland, and in the plain, and on the hill-slopes, and in the wilderness, and in the south: the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites and the Jebusites:

entries.title: Joshua 12:9
segments: The king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which is beside Bethel, one;

entries.title: Joshua 12:10
segments: the king of Jerusalem, one; the king of Hebron, one;

entries.title: Joshua 12:11
segments: the king of Jarmuth, one; the king of Lachish, one;

entries.title: Joshua 12:12
segments: the king of Eglon, one; the king of Gezer, one;

entries.title: Joshua 12:13
segments: the king of Debir, one; the king of Geder, one;

entries.title: Joshua 12:14
segments: the king of Hormah, one; the king of Arad, one;

entries.title: Joshua 12:15
segments: the king of Libnah, one; the king of Adullam, one;

entries.title: Joshua 12:16
segments: the king of Makkedah, one; the king of Bethel, one;

entries.title: Joshua 12:17
segments: the king of Tappuah, one; the king of Hepher, one;

entries.title: Joshua 12:18
segments: the king of Aphek, one; the king of Lasharon, one;

entries.title: Joshua 12:19
segments: the king of Madon, one; the king of Hazor, one;

entries.title: Joshua 12:20
segments: the king of Shimron-meron, one; the king of Achshaph, one;

entries.title: Joshua 12:21
segments: the king of Taanach, one; the king of Megiddo, one;

entries.title: Joshua 12:22
segments: the king of Kedesh, one; the king of Jokneam on Carmel, one;

entries.title: Joshua 12:23
segments: the king of Dor in the upland of Dor, one; the king of Goim, at Gilgal, one;

entries.title: Joshua 12:24
segments: the king of Tirzah, one: all the kings thirty and one.
